dict.string: LangMesh records what you say so it can be typed into the composer. The recording is transcribed on this Mac and sent nowhere else.

LangMesh uses other apps on your behalf — asking them and System Events to open pages, click, type, and report what is on screen — to carry out the tasks you ask for and to see which apps are open. Every action stays contained to one app, and this stays on your Mac.
LangMesh looks at the kinds of files on your Desktop and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
LangMesh looks at the kinds of files in your Documents and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
LangMesh looks at the kinds of files in your Downloads and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
LangMesh reads basic system information — hardware, uptime, connected devices — to tailor its help. This stays on your Mac.
